products.name: The Woodshed
products.tagline: A living lead sheet that teaches you to reharmonize.
products.consumerDescription: An advanced interactive jazz practice suite: a Comping Coach that listens to your voicings, an Improv Heatmap that scores your lines, and a Concept Passport dashboard where you earn stamps in all 12 keys.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Engineered an interactive reharmonization engine connecting via MIDI expression pedals for dynamic chord complexity. Built a background Web Worker pipeline for traced generation and an "Engine X-ray" view, handling state transitions across a global circle-of-fifths memory.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Live Practice Dashboard • MIDI Hardware Integrated

products.name: HeatReel
products.tagline: Skip to the parts everyone rewatches.
products.consumerDescription: A Chrome extension that auto-generates smart highlight reels on YouTube from the crowd's replay heatmap — with a custom mini-player overlay, keyboard shortcuts (Alt+S, Alt+X), and 1-click emoji-tiered timestamp comments.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Parses raw YouTube SVG heatmap path coordinates in real time, computing statistical intensity peaks (mean + standard deviation with a 15% fallback threshold) and syncing custom playback controls directly into the native video player lifecycle.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Live on Chrome Web Store • Zero-backend client-side processing

products.name: PsychoScanner
products.tagline: Grade your psychometric practice test in seconds.
products.consumerDescription: A mobile OMR scanner that grades official Israeli Psychometric Entrance Exam (פסיכומטרי) answer sheets in seconds with your phone camera — supporting 19 official NITE practice exams (2020–2026) and instant 0–150 scaled scoring.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Custom OpenCV pipeline featuring anchor detection, perspective and paper-bend flattening, adaptive illumination normalization for dim no-flash B&W printouts, and lone-mark leniency — paired with an automated NITE PDF answer-key parser (parse_nite_pdfs.py).
engineeringSpecs.metrics: 19 Official Exams Indexed • Sub-second OMR Grading Pipeline

products.name: Bet on Dave
products.tagline: Ragdoll stunts. Your friends bet on how you fail.
products.consumerDescription: A chaotic physics-driven multiplayer "friendslop" game where players execute ragdoll stunts and spectators wager on the outcomes.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Architected a host-authoritative state machine and core C# betting engine to synchronize physics-driven ragdoll mechanics and real-time spectator wagering over FishNet.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Multiplayer Netcode Prototype • Edit-Mode Test Suites Passing

products.name: Idea5
products.tagline: Five minutes a day. One idea at a time.
products.consumerDescription: An offline-first phone app for a daily 5-minute idea ritual: a countdown that never interrupts you, a Markdown notepad, voice notes, streaks, searchable history and a daily calendar reminder. No account and no backend — everything stays on your device.

engineeringSpecs.architectureHighlight: Drift-free timer modeled as accumulated time plus performance.now() deltas, so it survives throttled background tabs; debounced autosave with stale-draft recovery; voice clips stored as Blobs in Dexie with per-browser MIME detection; and zip backup/restore plus .ics reminder export — all on-device, with no server.
engineeringSpecs.metrics: Offline-first PWA • Zero backend • Unit-tested timer, streak & backup logic
